title: You don't have to carry this alone.
intro: Trauma-informed therapy for adults navigating PTSD, anxiety, grief, and life transitions. A gentle, collaborative approach — at your own pace.
availability: Accepting new clients · NY, NJ & CA · Virtual · In-person NYC
welcomeTitle: Healing at the pace of your nervous system
welcomeBody: Trauma doesn't follow a timeline, and neither does healing. My work is rooted in the belief that every person carries within them the capacity for recovery — sometimes it just needs the right conditions to emerge.
welcomeBodyTwo: Drawing from somatic, attachment-based, and EMDR-informed frameworks, I offer a space that is unhurried, non-judgmental, and deeply attuned to where you are right now. We move at the pace that feels safe for you.

areas.title: Trauma & PTSD
areas.body: Finding safety in your own body again.

areas.title: Anxiety
areas.body: Quieting the noise that won't let you rest.

areas.title: Grief & Loss
areas.body: Making space for what you've had to let go.
